projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.summary: A modern, full-stack e-commerce solution with real-time inventory management
projects.content:
Built a comprehensive e-commerce platform featuring:

• Real-time inventory tracking with WebSocket updates
• Secure payment gateway integration (Stripe, PayPal)
• Advanced product filtering and search with Elasticsearch
• User authentication and authorization with JWT
• Admin dashboard with analytics and reporting
• Responsive design optimized for all devices

This project demonstrates expertise in full-stack development, database optimization, and user experience design. Achieved 99.5% uptime with 10K+ daily active users.

projects.title: Mobile App - Task Manager
projects.summary: iOS and Android task management app with cloud synchronization
projects.content:
Developed a cross-platform mobile application that helps users manage tasks efficiently:

• Cloud synchronization across devices with real-time updates
• Offline-first architecture for seamless experience
• Beautiful and intuitive UI following Material Design
• Push notifications for task reminders
• End-to-end data encryption and privacy
• Collaborative task sharing with team members
• Integration with Google Calendar and Slack

Optimized for performance with 60 FPS animations and zero-jank scrolling. Achieved 4.8-star rating with 50K+ downloads.

projects.title: Machine Learning Model - Image Recognition
projects.summary: Deep learning model for accurate image classification and object detection
projects.content:
Created and deployed an advanced machine learning model for image recognition:

• TensorFlow-based CNN architecture with custom layers
• Trained on 100K+ images achieving 95% accuracy
• Real-time object detection and classification
• RESTful API endpoint for easy integration
• Model optimization for edge devices using TensorFlow Lite
• Comprehensive documentation and usage examples
• Continuous improvement with active learning

Currently used in production for various client applications processing 1M+ images daily.

projects.title: SaaS Dashboard - Analytics Platform
projects.summary: Enterprise-grade analytics and reporting dashboard for data visualization
projects.content:
Engineered a powerful analytics platform for business intelligence:

• Real-time data processing and visualization
• Custom report generation with drag-and-drop interface
• Advanced filtering and drill-down capabilities
• Multi-tenant architecture with data isolation
• Role-based access control (RBAC)
• Performance optimization for large datasets (1B+ rows)
• Export to multiple formats (PDF, Excel, CSV)
• Integration with data warehouses and APIs

Serves 500+ enterprise clients with 99.9% uptime SLA and handles 10K+ concurrent users.

projects.title: Open Source Library - React Components
projects.summary: Comprehensive library of reusable React components for developers
projects.content:
Created and maintained an open-source React component library:

• 50+ pre-built, customizable components
• Full TypeScript support with type definitions
• Comprehensive Storybook documentation
• Extensive test coverage (95% code coverage)
• Accessibility (a11y) compliant (WCAG 2.1 AA)
• Performance optimized with code splitting
• Active community with 2K+ GitHub stars
• Semantic versioning and backward compatibility
• NPM package with 10K+ weekly downloads

Community contributions from 100+ developers worldwide with active maintenance and regular updates.
